newsitem.title: USA: Nobel Education sees 1997 EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Nobel Education sees 1997 EPS growth.

text.p: Nobel Education Dynamics Inc said on Tuesday that it sees 1997 net income and earnings per share growth between 15 and 20 percent.
The company said it expects 1997 revenue growth to be between 35 and 45 percent, and pretax profits growth between 25 and 30 percent.

Nobel Education said its strategy includes expanding enrollment at current schools, strategically acquiring preschool and elementary school systems and opening new schools to expand in existing and new markets.
